## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL

## Summary

Adds `precision="mxfp4"` to the SM100 DSA indexer: the indexer forward, the compressed top-k path and the dense indexer score recompute, in BSHD and THD.

The MXFP4 kernel, `IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100Mxfp4`, subclasses the MXFP8 indexer-score kernel and changes only the MMA: packed E2M1 Q/K issue `tcgen05.mma.kind::mxf4` (K = 64) instead of `kind::mxf8f6f4` (K = 32). MXFP8 behavior is unchanged.

- **Q/K:** `torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2`, two values per byte (element `2i` in the low nibble), last dim `head_dim // 2`.
- **Scales:** the same E8M0 scales as MXFP8 (one per 32 elements), from the same packers. Weights stay BF16.
- **Shapes:** the MXFP8 head groups (`qhead_per_kv_head` in {4, 8, 16, 32, 64}; {32, 64} for dense recompute), `H_kv = 1`, `head_dim = 128`.
- **Validation:** one table in `score_recompute/_block_scaled.py` lists each block-scaled format's dtypes and scale vector size, and every entry point validates against it.

## Why

MXFP4 halves the Q/K bytes and doubles the MMA rate of MXFP8, and reuses its scale format and everything in its kernel except the MMA. At 64 heads it is 1.07–1.12x faster than MXFP8 on R100 and 1.00–1.03x on B300, except the smallest prefill (P4K), where B300 is 0.95x. See Performance.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

- `indexer_forward_wrapper`, `indexer_forward_top_k_wrapper` and `dense_indexer_score_recompute_wrapper` accept `precision="mxfp4"` on cc 10.0, 10.3 and 10.7. `dense_attn_score_recompute_wrapper` rejects it, and SM90 declines it.
- `compress_topk_cand_buffer_size` gets a trailing `precision="bf16"` parameter. Block-scaled launches never microbatch, so they are sized as one launch. This also fixes the MXFP8 buffer size at long sequences.
- A Q/K last-dim mismatch now raises `ValueError` in the dense indexer forward and dense score recompute. It was an `assert` in THD and unchecked in BSHD.
- MXFP4 needs a PyTorch build with `torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2` and `torch.float8_e8m0fnu`. Without them, `import cudnn` still works and `precision="mxfp4"` raises `NotImplementedError`.

## Testing

From `test/python`:

```bash
pytest deepseek_sparse_attention/cutedsl/test_DSA_indexer_forward.py \
       deepseek_sparse_attention/cutedsl/test_DSA_indexer_forward_compressed.py \
       deepseek_sparse_attention/cutedsl/test_DSA_mxfp8_scale_utils.py \
       deepseek_sparse_attention/cutedsl/test_DSA_dense_score_recompute.py -m "L0 or L1"
```

229 passed, 28 skipped on each of B200 (cc 10.0), B300 (cc 10.3) and R100 (cc 10.7).

New tests cover:

- numerics against a dequantized reference for every head group, BSHD and THD, including query tails and zero-key rows;
- both GEMM paths, top-k with LSE and fused softmax, and dense recompute;
- input rejections and SM90 declines;
- import on a PyTorch build without the FP4/E8M0 dtypes;
- E2M1 rounding and `kind::mxf4` descriptor goldens.

## Performance

Speedup of MXFP4 over MXFP8 in indexer kernel time (higher is better), `head_dim` 128, compression ratio 4.

| Case | 64 heads, R100 | 64 heads, B300 | 32 heads, R100 | 32 heads, B300 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| P4K | 1.10x | 0.95x | | |
| P16K | 1.10x | 1.02x | 1.08x | 1.02x |
| P64K | 1.09x | 1.01x | 1.05x | 1.02x |
| P128K | 1.09x | 1.02x | | |
| C8K@32K | 1.09x | 1.01x | | |
| C8K@128K | 1.08x | 1.02x | 1.02x | 1.03x |
| C8K@256K | 1.08x | 1.02x | 1.02x | 1.03x |
| B8x4K | 1.12x | 1.03x | 1.11x | 1.02x |
| Bmix31K | 1.09x | 1.03x | 1.09x | 1.05x |
| B4xC2K@32K | 1.07x | 1.00x | | |

- `P<n>`: a prefill of `n` tokens. `C8K@<n>`: the last 8K-token chunk of an `n`-token context.
- Batched THD: `B8x4K` is eight 4K prefills, `Bmix31K` is 1K + 2K + 4K + 8K + 16K, and `B4xC2K@32K` is four 2K chunks of 32K contexts.
- Method: SM clock locked at 1500 MHz, plus the memory clock on B300 (R100 refused a memory-clock lock). Five alternating MXFP4 / MXFP8 process pairs per case; the table shows the median per-pair speedup. Between-run CV is at most 0.8% everywhere.

The speedup is far below the 2x MMA rate because the kernel is bound by its FP32 score epilogue, not the MMA. On B300 at 64 heads (`C8K@256K`), MXFP4 halves tensor-pipe activity (21% vs 41% of peak) while the ALU pipe stays at about 55%.

+    q_scale_logical = torch.ldexp(torch.ones_like(q_exponents), q_exponents).expand(1, s_q, h_q, d // 32).contiguous().to(torch.float8_e8m0fnu)
+    k_scale_logical = torch.ldexp(torch.ones_like(k_exponents), k_exponents).expand(1, s_k, 1, d // 32).contiguous().to(torch.float8_e8m0fnu)
+    q_scale = scale_utils.pack_q_scale_bshd(q_scale_logical, qhead_per_kv_head=h_q)
+    k_scale = scale_utils.pack_k_scale_bshd(k_scale_logical)

+        in_group = (torch.arange(d, device=device) // 32 == group).float()
+        q, q_deq = quantize_e2m1(torch.rand(1, s_q, h_q, d, device=device) * 6 * in_group * expand_mxfp8_scale(q_scale_logical, d), q_scale_logical)
+        k, k_deq = quantize_e2m1(torch.rand(1, s_k, 1, d, device=device) * 6 * in_group * expand_mxfp8_scale(k_scale_logical, d), k_scale_logical)

+        result = DSA.indexer_forward_wrapper(q, k, w, ratio=ratio, q_causal_offsets=q_causal_offsets, precision="mxfp4", q_scale=q_scale, k_scale=k_scale)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+        scores = result["scores"]
+        assert bool((scores[torch.isfinite(scores)] > 0).all()), f"group {group}: a visible score is zero"
+        check_ref_indexer_forward(q_deq, k_deq, w, scores, ratio, q_causal_offsets=q_causal_offsets, atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-3)
+

+@pytest.mark.L0
+@torch_fork_set_rng(seed=27)

+def test_DSA_indexer_forward_mxfp4_two_mmas_per_k_chunk(monkeypatch, ratio):

detail.body:
## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL

## Summary

Adds `precision="mxfp4"` to the SM100 DSA indexer: the indexer forward, the compressed top-k path and the dense indexer score recompute, in BSHD and THD.

The MXFP4 kernel, `IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100Mxfp4`, subclasses the MXFP8 indexer-score kernel and changes only the MMA: packed E2M1 Q/K issue `tcgen05.mma.kind::mxf4` (K = 64) instead of `kind::mxf8f6f4` (K = 32). MXFP8 behavior is unchanged.

- **Q/K:** `torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2`, two values per byte (element `2i` in the low nibble), last dim `head_dim // 2`.
- **Scales:** the same E8M0 scales as MXFP8 (one per 32 elements), from the same packers. Weights stay BF16.
- **Shapes:** the MXFP8 head groups (`qhead_per_kv_head` in {4, 8, 16, 32, 64}; {32, 64} for dense recompute), `H_kv = 1`, `head_dim = 128`.
- **Validation:** one table in `score_recompute/_block_scaled.py` lists each block-scaled format's dtypes and scale vector size, and every entry point validates against it.

## Why

MXFP4 halves the Q/K bytes and doubles the MMA rate of MXFP8, and reuses its scale format and everything in its kernel except the MMA. At 64 heads it is 1.07–1.12x faster than MXFP8 on R100 and 1.00–1.03x on B300, except the smallest prefill (P4K), where B300 is 0.95x. See Performance.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

- `indexer_forward_wrapper`, `indexer_forward_top_k_wrapper` and `dense_indexer_score_recompute_wrapper` accept `precision="mxfp4"` on cc 10.0, 10.3 and 10.7. `dense_attn_score_recompute_wrapper` rejects it, and SM90 declines it.
- `compress_topk_cand_buffer_size` gets a trailing `precision="bf16"` parameter. Block-scaled launches never microbatch, so they are sized as one launch. This also fixes the MXFP8 buffer size at long sequences.
- A Q/K last-dim mismatch now raises `ValueError` in the dense indexer forward and dense score recompute. It was an `assert` in THD and unchecked in BSHD.
- MXFP4 needs a PyTorch build with `torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2` and `torch.float8_e8m0fnu`. Without them, `import cudnn` still works and `precision="mxfp4"` raises `NotImplementedError`.

## Testing

From `test/python`:

```bash
pytest deepseek_sparse_attention/cutedsl/test_DSA_indexer_forward.py \
       deepseek_sparse_attention/cutedsl/test_DSA_indexer_forward_compressed.py \
       deepseek_sparse_attention/cutedsl/test_DSA_mxfp8_scale_utils.py \
       deepseek_sparse_attention/cutedsl/test_DSA_dense_score_recompute.py -m "L0 or L1"
```

229 passed, 28 skipped on each of B200 (cc 10.0), B300 (cc 10.3) and R100 (cc 10.7).

New tests cover:

- numerics against a dequantized reference for every head group, BSHD and THD, including query tails and zero-key rows;
- both GEMM paths, top-k with LSE and fused softmax, and dense recompute;
- input rejections and SM90 declines;
- import on a PyTorch build without the FP4/E8M0 dtypes;
- E2M1 rounding and `kind::mxf4` descriptor goldens.

## Performance

Speedup of MXFP4 over MXFP8 in indexer kernel time (higher is better), `head_dim` 128, compression ratio 4.

| Case | 64 heads, R100 | 64 heads, B300 | 32 heads, R100 | 32 heads, B300 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| P4K | 1.10x | 0.95x | | |
| P16K | 1.10x | 1.02x | 1.08x | 1.02x |
| P64K | 1.09x | 1.01x | 1.05x | 1.02x |
| P128K | 1.09x | 1.02x | | |
| C8K@32K | 1.09x | 1.01x | | |
| C8K@128K | 1.08x | 1.02x | 1.02x | 1.03x |
| C8K@256K | 1.08x | 1.02x | 1.02x | 1.03x |
| B8x4K | 1.12x | 1.03x | 1.11x | 1.02x |
| Bmix31K | 1.09x | 1.03x | 1.09x | 1.05x |
| B4xC2K@32K | 1.07x | 1.00x | | |

- `P<n>`: a prefill of `n` tokens. `C8K@<n>`: the last 8K-token chunk of an `n`-token context.
- Batched THD: `B8x4K` is eight 4K prefills, `Bmix31K` is 1K + 2K + 4K + 8K + 16K, and `B4xC2K@32K` is four 2K chunks of 32K contexts.
- Method: SM clock locked at 1500 MHz, plus the memory clock on B300 (R100 refused a memory-clock lock). Five alternating MXFP4 / MXFP8 process pairs per case; the table shows the median per-pair speedup. Between-run CV is at most 0.8% everywhere.

The speedup is far below the 2x MMA rate because the kernel is bound by its FP32 score epilogue, not the MMA. On B300 at 64 heads (`C8K@256K`), MXFP4 halves tensor-pipe activity (21% vs 41% of peak) while the ALU pipe stays at about 55%.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Block-scaled Q/K precisions of the SM100 indexer kernels.
+
+``BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS`` maps each precision to its Q/K and scale dtypes, its
+scale vector size along head_dim and its kernel class. The indexer forward
+(dense and compressed-logits) and the dense indexer score recompute validate
+against it; the MXFP8 dense attention score reuses the MXFP8 entry.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from cudnn.deepseek_sparse_attention.utils.runtime import ceil_div
+from .indexer_score_unified_sm100 import IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100
+from .indexer_score_unified_sm100_mxfp4 import IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100Mxfp4
+from .indexer_score_unified_sm100_mxfp8 import IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100Mxfp8
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class BlockScaledFormat:
+    """Q/K storage contract of a block-scaled indexer precision.
+
+    ``data_dtype`` / ``scale_dtype`` resolve the named torch dtypes of Q/K and
+    their scales, or are ``None`` when the installed torch lacks them
+    (``validate_indexer_precision`` reports that). One stored element holds
+    ``elems_per_storage`` logical head_dim values (2 for packed FP4, whose last
+    dim is ``head_dim // 2``); each scale covers ``sf_vec_size`` of them.
+    """
+
+    data_dtype_name: str
+    scale_dtype_name: str
+    sf_vec_size: int
+    elems_per_storage: int
+    kernel_cls: type[IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100]
+
+    @property
+    def data_dtype(self) -> Optional[torch.dtype]:
+        return getattr(torch, self.data_dtype_name, None)
+
+    @property
+    def scale_dtype(self) -> Optional[torch.dtype]:
+        return getattr(torch, self.scale_dtype_name, None)
+
+
+BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS = {
+    "mxfp8": BlockScaledFormat(
+        data_dtype_name="float8_e4m3fn",
+        scale_dtype_name="float8_e8m0fnu",
+        sf_vec_size=32,
+        elems_per_storage=1,
+        kernel_cls=IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100Mxfp8,
+    ),
+    "mxfp4": BlockScaledFormat(
+        data_dtype_name="float4_e2m1fn_x2",
+        scale_dtype_name="float8_e8m0fnu",
+        sf_vec_size=32,
+        elems_per_storage=2,
+        kernel_cls=IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100Mxfp4,
+    ),
+}
+SM100_INDEXER_PRECISIONS = ("bf16", *BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS)
+# Block-scaled precision names for error messages: "'mxfp8' or 'mxfp4'".
+BLOCK_SCALED_PRECISION_NAMES = " or ".join(repr(name) for name in BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS)
+# The only logical head dim the block-scaled indexer kernels support.
+BLOCK_SCALED_HEAD_DIM = 128
+
+
+def validate_indexer_precision(precision: str) -> str:
+    """Lowercase ``precision`` and reject one the SM100 indexer or the installed torch does not support."""
+    precision = precision.lower()
+    if precision not in SM100_INDEXER_PRECISIONS:
+        raise ValueError(f"precision must be one of {SM100_INDEXER_PRECISIONS}, got {precision!r}")
+    fmt = BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS.get(precision)
+    if fmt is not None:
+        missing = [name for name in (fmt.data_dtype_name, fmt.scale_dtype_name) if getattr(torch, name, None) is None]
+        if missing:
+            raise NotImplementedError(f"precision={precision!r} requires a torch build with " + " and ".join(f"torch.{name}" for name in missing))
+    return precision
+
+
+def validate_sf_vec_size(precision: str, sf_vec_size: int) -> None:
+    """A block-scaled ``precision`` requires its format's scale vector size (``ValueError`` otherwise)."""
+    fmt = BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS.get(precision)
+    if fmt is not None and sf_vec_size != fmt.sf_vec_size:
+        raise ValueError(f"precision={precision!r} currently requires sf_vec_size={fmt.sf_vec_size}")
+
+
+def validate_block_scaled_inputs(
+    precision: str,
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    w: torch.Tensor,
+    q_scale: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    k_scale: Optional[torch.Tensor],

+    fmt = BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS[precision]

+        raise TypeError(f"precision={precision!r} requires q and k to be {fmt.data_dtype}")
+    if w.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        raise TypeError(f"precision={precision!r} requires w to be torch.bfloat16")
+    if q_scale is None or k_scale is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"precision={precision!r} requires q_scale and k_scale")
+    if q_scale.dtype != fmt.scale_dtype or k_scale.dtype != fmt.scale_dtype:
+        raise TypeError(f"precision={precision!r} requires q_scale and k_scale to be {fmt.scale_dtype}")

+        raise ValueError("q_scale/k_scale must be on the same device as q/k")

+
+def logical_head_dim(precision: str, storage_head_dim: int) -> int:
+    """Logical head dim of Q/K whose last dim is ``storage_head_dim``.
+

+    otherwise this raises ``ValueError`` naming the stored last dim it needs.
+    """
+    fmt = BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS.get(precision)
+    if fmt is None:
+        return storage_head_dim
+    head_dim = storage_head_dim * fmt.elems_per_storage
+    if head_dim != BLOCK_SCALED_HEAD_DIM:
+        stored = BLOCK_SCALED_HEAD_DIM // fmt.elems_per_storage
+        packing = f" ({fmt.elems_per_storage} values per torch.{fmt.data_dtype_name} element)" if fmt.elems_per_storage > 1 else ""
+        raise ValueError(f"precision={precision!r} requires head_dim={BLOCK_SCALED_HEAD_DIM}, stored as q/k last dim {stored}{packing}; got {storage_head_dim}")
+    return head_dim
+
+
+def kernel_qk_view(precision: str, t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Q or K as the ``precision`` kernel is compiled and launched with.
+
+    A packed format (more than one value per stored element) passes its raw bytes
+    as a ``torch.uint8`` view, which the kernel recasts to its element type: CuTe
+    DSL before 4.8 binds a ``torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2`` tensor with its packed shape
+    and strides, not the E2M1 ones the kernel is compiled for. Other precisions
+    pass ``t`` unchanged.
+    """
+    fmt = BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS.get(precision)
+    if fmt is None or fmt.elems_per_storage == 1:
+        return t
+    return t.view(torch.uint8)

+
+def bshd_packed_scale_shape(
+    *,
+    bs: int,
+    seqlen: int,
+    n_heads_kv: int,
+    sf_groups: int,
+    pack_q_heads: int = 1,

+    """Shape ``(L, padded_MN, padded_sf_groups)`` of BSHD blockscaled-packed scales.
+
+    ``MN = seqlen * pack_q_heads`` rounds up to 128 rows and the scale groups
+    to 4 columns.
+    """
+    mn = seqlen * pack_q_heads
+    return (
+        bs * n_heads_kv,
+        ceil_div(mn, 128) * 128,
+        ceil_div(sf_groups, 4) * 4,
+    )
+
+
+def validate_thd_scale_contract(
+    q_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    k_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens_q_scale_padded: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    cu_seqlens_k_scale_padded: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    *,
+    precision: str,
+    bs: int,
+    n_heads_kv: int,
+    sf_groups: int,
+    device: torch.device,

+    """Check the THD scale padded prefixes and the packed ``(n_heads_kv, multiple_of_128, padded_sf_groups)`` scales."""
+    if cu_seqlens_q_scale_padded is None or cu_seqlens_k_scale_padded is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"THD {precision.upper()} requires Q/K scale padded cu_seqlens")
+
+    for prefix, name in (
+        (cu_seqlens_q_scale_padded, "cu_seqlens_q_scale_padded"),
+        (cu_seqlens_k_scale_padded, "cu_seqlens_k_scale_padded"),
+    ):
+        if prefix.dtype != torch.int32 or prefix.ndim != 1 or prefix.shape[0] != bs + 1 or not prefix.is_contiguous() or prefix.device != device:

+
+    sf_padded = ceil_div(sf_groups, 4) * 4
+    for scale, name in ((q_scale, "q_scale"), (k_scale, "k_scale")):
+        if scale.ndim != 3:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 3D packed scale tensor")
+        if scale.shape[0] != n_heads_kv or scale.shape[1] % 128 != 0 or scale.shape[2] != sf_padded:
+            raise ValueError(f"THD {name} must have shape ({n_heads_kv}, multiple_of_128, " f"{sf_padded}), got {tuple(scale.shape)}")
+        if scale.device != device:
+            raise ValueError("q_scale/k_scale must be on the same device as q/k")

+
+MXFP4 Q/K are packed E2M1 (two values per byte) with one E8M0 scale per 32
+head_dim elements, the scale format of MXFP8.  The kernel runs the MXFP8

+    """MXFP4 dense score kernel with unified indexer output semantics."""

+            raise TypeError(f"SM100 unified indexer MXFP4 expects Q/K launched as Uint8 bytes, got {t.element_type}")

+        The unscaled tcgen05 kinds read E2M1 only in the padded f8f6f4 format, not packed.
+        """
+        return blockscaled_tiled_mma_qk

+    # a power of two, and data read from the wrong group is zero and zeroes it.
+    q_exponents = torch.tensor([-6.0, -2.0, 2.0, 6.0], device=device)

+    k_scale_logical = torch.ldexp(torch.ones_like(k_exponents), k_exponents).expand(1, s_k, 1, d // 32).contiguous().to(torch.float8_e8m0fnu)
+    q_scale = scale_utils.pack_q_scale_bshd(q_scale_logical, qhead_per_kv_head=h_q)
+    k_scale = scale_utils.pack_k_scale_bshd(k_scale_logical)
+    w = torch.rand(1, s_q, h_q, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device) + 0.5
+    q_causal_offsets = torch.tensor([ratio * s_k - s_q], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+
+    for group in range(d // 32):
+        # Non-negative data: no head's dot product is hidden by the ReLU.
+        in_group = (torch.arange(d, device=device) // 32 == group).float()
+        q, q_deq = quantize_e2m1(torch.rand(1, s_q, h_q, d, device=device) * 6 * in_group * expand_mxfp8_scale(q_scale_logical, d), q_scale_logical)

+    group_scales = torch.tensor([block_scale, 2 * block_scale])

+    expected = torch.cat([rounded, -rounded]).repeat(2) * group_scales.repeat_interleave(32)

+    k_scale = scale_utils.pack_k_scale_bshd(k_scale_logical)
+    w = torch.rand(1, s_q, h_q, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device) + 0.5
+    q_causal_offsets = torch.tensor([ratio * s_k - s_q], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+
+    for group in range(d // 32):
+        # Non-negative data: no head's dot product is hidden by the ReLU.
+        in_group = (torch.arange(d, device=device) // 32 == group).float()
+        q, q_deq = quantize_e2m1(torch.rand(1, s_q, h_q, d, device=device) * 6 * in_group * expand_mxfp8_scale(q_scale_logical, d), q_scale_logical)
+        k, k_deq = quantize_e2m1(torch.rand(1, s_k, 1, d, device=device) * 6 * in_group * expand_mxfp8_scale(k_scale_logical, d), k_scale_logical)
+
+        result = DSA.indexer_forward_wrapper(q, k, w, ratio=ratio, q_causal_offsets=q_causal_offsets, precision="mxfp4", q_scale=q_scale, k_scale=k_scale)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+        scores = result["scores"]
+        assert bool((scores[torch.isfinite(scores)] > 0).all()), f"group {group}: a visible score is zero"
+        check_ref_indexer_forward(q_deq, k_deq, w, scores, ratio, q_causal_offsets=q_causal_offsets, atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-3)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.L0
+@torch_fork_set_rng(seed=27)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ratio", [4, 1], ids=["direct_ptx", "cute_gemm"])
+def test_DSA_indexer_forward_mxfp4_two_mmas_per_k_chunk(monkeypatch, ratio):
+    """128-wide K chunks issue two K=64 MXFP4 MMAs per chunk, each reading its own pair of E8M0 scale groups."""
+    DSA = pytest.importorskip("cudnn.deepseek_sparse_attention", reason="Environment not supported: cudnn[cutedsl] not installed").DSA
+    _require_mxfp4_indexer()

+    from cudnn.deepseek_sparse_attention.score_recompute import _block_scaled
+    from cudnn.deepseek_sparse_attention.score_recompute.indexer_score_unified_sm100_mxfp4 import IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100Mxfp4
+    from deepseek_sparse_attention.cutedsl import mxfp8_scale_reference as scale_utils
+
+    constructed = []
+
+    class WideKChunk(IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100Mxfp4):
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            constructed.append(kwargs)
+            super().__init__(*args, **{**kwargs, "k_block_size": 128, "kv_stage": 12})
+
+    monkeypatch.setitem(_block_scaled.BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS, "mxfp4", dataclasses.replace(_block_scaled.BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS["mxfp4"], kernel_cls=WideKChunk))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(_interface, "_compile_cache", {})
+
+    device = "cuda"
+    h_q, d = 64, 128
+    s_q, s_k = (128, 384) if ratio == 4 else (64, 256)
+    q, q_ref, q_scale_logical = make_random_mxfp4((1, s_q, h_q, d), device=device, seed=211)
+    k, k_ref, k_scale_logical = make_random_mxfp4((1, s_k, 1, d), device=device, seed=213)
+    q_scale = scale_utils.pack_q_scale_bshd(q_scale_logical, qhead_per_kv_head=h_q)
+    k_scale = scale_utils.pack_k_scale_bshd(k_scale_logical)
+    w = torch.randn(1, s_q, h_q, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device).abs() * 0.1
+    q_causal_offsets = torch.tensor([ratio * s_k - s_q], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+
+    result = DSA.indexer_forward_wrapper(q, k, w, ratio=ratio, q_causal_offsets=q_causal_offsets, precision="mxfp4", q_scale=q_scale, k_scale=k_scale)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    assert constructed, "the MXFP4 indexer did not build the 128-wide K-chunk kernel"
+    check_ref_indexer_forward(q_ref, k_ref, w, result["scores"], ratio, q_causal_offsets=q_causal_offsets, atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-3)
+
+

Changing only the isolated DSL installation to 4.8.1 makes the fixed-input matrix and all 51 selected MXFP4 tests pass. Add an MXFP4-specific runtime gate to a validated version/configuration, or correct and test the older path; retain the existing BF16/MXFP8 support. This blocks approval because a currently accepted public configuration silently returns incorrect results. See Rule 7 and checklist D10.
